_comment: Captures Chez at its strongest vs capped Stockfish. Changes from the old config and WHY: (1) threads=4 (Chez default, Lazy SMP) — strength is hugely thread-sensitive (baseline measured 0.56@1t -> 0.89@2t vs SF_2400), so 1-thread gauntlets undersell Chez badly; 4t@conc3 = 15/16 cores, clean timing, no oversubscription. (2) Opponent ladder shifted UP and SF_2400 dropped — at threads=2 baseline already beat SF_2400 +24-2 (saturated, ±249 Elo, uninformative); informative cells are where Chez scores 30-70%, which at 4t is ~SF_2800-3190. (3) rounds=100 (200 games/opp) -> ~±50 Elo CI instead of ±250. (4) balanced 8moves opening book for representative absolute Elo + lower variance + no repeated lines. (5) SF kept at Threads=1: with UCI_LimitStrength its skill is fixed by UCI_Elo regardless of threads, so extra SF threads do nothing and would only steal cores from Chez. SF UCI_Elo caps at 3190; if Chez sweeps 3190, switch the top rung to fixed-NODES full-strength SF (UCI_LimitStrength=false, e.g. nodes=200000) — capped SF cannot measure above 3190.
